module_summary: Serial two's complementer: a 3-state Moore FSM steered by serial input x, with output z decoded from state C.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 3-state Moore register (A,B,C) tracking whether first 1 bit seen; decides output inversion.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Serial complemented output bit, decoded from state==C.

groups.name: complementer_fsm
groups.description: Moore FSM consuming serial x bits and emitting the two's complement on z.
